name: Aban Offshore Ltd
tagline: Once India's largest private offshore-drilling contractor, now a distressed shell: under the insolvency process (CIRP) since September 2025, negative net worth, ~Rs 1,270 Cr contingent liabilities, and a five-year revenue decline of ~-17.5%.
business_overview: Offshore drilling rig owner/operator - jack-ups and drillships contracted on day-rates to E&P operators. A classic rig-utilisation / day-rate cycle play in principle, but the company was overwhelmed by debt taken on during the 2007-08 rig-acquisition boom and has been in restructuring for over a decade. Seeded via theme-scan 2026-09-09 (user-authorised 1x no-self-discovery bypass), oilfield-services / offshore-drilling theme, with an explicit balance-sheet caution in the seed note.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 85 - 107 Cr (trades as a distressed equity stub)
Contingent liabilities ~Rs 1,270 Cr; low interest coverage; under CIRP
Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since Sept 2025; proceedings stayed Jan 2026
fundamentals_narrative: The day-rate cycle is turning up globally, which is why the seed came in - but Aban cannot participate. It is in the insolvency process, its net worth is negative, and the equity is a residual claim behind a large creditor stack. Any recovery value accrues to lenders and a resolution applicant first. This is a red-flag exclusion, not an investment case.
